title: Sam Altman just revealed AGI is 2 years away — here is what that means

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: If AGI arrives in two years, what must we prepare for — and what can't we control?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Current models lack common sense and long-term planning, but progress in transformers and reinforcement learning is accelerating.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Societal trust could erode if AGI decisions are opaque, leading to misuse in governance or warfare.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Researchers are prioritizing alignment frameworks and open-source oversight to ensure safe development.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: A world where AGI aids in curing diseases and solving climate change is within reach if we align values with technology.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The next two years will define whether AGI becomes our greatest ally or our most dangerous experiment.
